cases.case_label: Alu at BUB1B intron 8/exon 9 acceptor (PCS/MVA syndrome)
cases.disease: Premature chromatid separation / mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: A paternally inherited Alu inserted just before the AG of the intron 8 / exon 9 splice acceptor (in trans with a maternal upstream variant) produced a smaller exon 8-10 RT-PCR product derived from the Alu allele, consistent with loss of exon 9; only the abstract and figure legends are available.
cases.quote: An Alu element was found to be inserted just before the AG consensus dinucleotide at the splicing acceptor in the proband and father.
